verdict.rationale: Exa documents its own Contents API, which returns clean page content from URLs, including JavaScript-rendered pages and PDFs. The same contents features can be requested on Search results, so developers get page content beyond highlight excerpts. However, no evidence explicitly names a full-text field or a markdown output format, and a hands-on user asked for a cruft cleaner to trim what reaches the LLM. missing for 10: explicit documentation of full-page text vs. truncated output, markdown output format, independent hands-on confirmation of full-text retrieval quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can retrieve full page text or markdown for results, not just snippets

citations.quote: Exa Contents is a content extraction API that returns clean page content from URLs, handling JavaScript-rendered pages, PDFs, and complex layouts automatically.
returns ranked web results with clean page content
All contents features are also available in Exa Search for returned URLs, at no extra charge up to 10 results per search ($1/1000 pages afterwards).
